title: 9 Lines a Godly Man Draws Before the First Drink
caption:
Most guys draw their lines after the third drink, which means they don't draw them at all.

A godly man decides sober. His number, his ride, his exit, the brother who can tell him that's enough. Self-control is a fruit of the Spirit, and it grows best in the decisions you make before you walk in.

Send this to the guy you go out with.

#faith #godlyman #selfcontrol #christianmen
theme: He runs his life — his impulses don't control him.
